title.narrative: Strengthened capacity of member States to ratify and apply international labour standards and to fulfil their reporting obligations

description.narrative: Building on the significant progress in human development and poverty reduction made by Azerbaijan, the ILO will support the tripartite constituents to address the application of fundamental principles and rights at work. The ILO will also support conducting gap analysis and reviews of national laws and preparing for ratification of conventions through sharing experiences with other Member States. The capacities of constituents and relevant stakeholders will be enhanced to effectively apply ratified conventions, with a focus on fundamental instruments and ensure that normative commitments translate into measurable progress towards social justice and improved working conditions.

activity-date.narrative: Planned start date of the activity

sector.narrative: 16.7 Ensure responsive, inclusive, participatory and representative decision-making at all levels
8.5 By 2030, achieve full and productive employment and decent work for all women and men, including for young people and persons with disabilities, and equal pay for work of equal value

8.7 Take immediate and effective measures to eradicate forced labour, end modern slavery and human trafficking and secure the prohibition and elimination of the worst forms of child labour, including recruitment and use of child soldiers, and by 2025 end child labour in all its forms
8.8 Protect labour rights and promote safe and secure working environments for all workers, including migrant workers, in particular women migrants, and those in precarious employment
